description: This source file defines the code-behind logic for the LoginPage of an online examination system. It handles user login for both students and teachers/admins, including database validation for students and hardcoded check for the admin. It manages session variables and page transfers based on login success.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Partial class representing the login page, managing user authentication and redirection.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load, currently does nothing.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Handles the signup button click, transfers user to SignUpPage.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Processes the login request, validates user credentials against database or hardcoded admin credentials, and redirects accordingly.
